Start Your Academy Project

Customer-project reference. Artwork shown on the supplied garment is retained for reference; your project uses your own approved branding.

Artwork and construction for your academy

Map and alpine artwork

The customer photograph shows a white base with fine gray map lines, blue mountain and tree illustrations, gold accents and academy lettering. Develop your own authorized graphic direction and approve printed panel layouts.

Raglan short-sleeve construction

The reference uses a close-fitting short-sleeve silhouette with raglan-style shoulder lines. Approve garment measurements, sleeve opening and shoulder movement with a fit sample.

Flatlock construction brief

Four-needle, six-thread flatlock stitching is specified in the supplied construction brief. Verify stitch type, seam stretch and the inner finish on the physical sample.

Material and finish approval

Confirm fiber percentages, GSM, stretch recovery, opacity, moisture management and wash performance in the project specification. Confirm the inner-label method and hem construction with the approved sample.

Alpine Map design presentation

Supplied generated design presentation. Use the customer photograph and approved physical sample to verify actual garment construction and artwork.

Buyer questions

Can this artwork be adapted for my academy?

Use this customer reference to discuss your own map, local landscape, academy logo and colors. Supply artwork you are authorized to use; final panel layouts and branding are approved before production.

Is this an official 10th Planet retail release?

This page presents a TONTON customer-project reference carrying the artwork shown in the supplied photograph. It does not claim an official retail release, exclusive partnership or governing-body approval.

What are the fabric composition and weight?

Fiber percentages and GSM are confirmed against the approved material specification for your project. Request a swatch and fit sample before bulk production.

How should I check the printing and seams?

Review a printed sample for map-line clarity, panel alignment, color and appearance under stretch. The construction brief specifies four-needle, six-thread flatlock stitching; confirm stitch construction and the skin-side finish on the physical sample.

What did the buyer say about this order?

The supplied Alibaba screenshot shows a five-star review from M***r, a United States repeat buyer, dated September 21, 2025: “The print looked great, high quality material and stitching. Fast shipping and attention to detail.” This describes that customer’s order, rather than a general delivery or quality guarantee.
